newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks storm higher to record close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks storm higher to record close.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended higher on Tuesday propelling the market's index to a record close, powered by interest in the electricity sector, a higher dollar and strong gains in other key stock markets, dealers said.
The general index rose 4.83 points, or 1.30 percent, to close at 377.52. The IBEX-35 ended 62.69 points, 1.46 percent, higher at 4,328.36 in heavy trade.
"The strength in the electricity sector together with rises in other stock markets and the dollar has spurred the market," said a dealer at Renta 4.
Dealers said reduced fear of tougher regulations and increased competition in the electricity companies had attracted buying interest in that sector.
Spain's largest electrical group Endesa was one of the biggest movers on the day climbing 270 pesetas to 7,940.
Government plans to sell off stakes in Telefonica, Repsol and Endesa also lent support to the market, dealers added.
Telefonica rose 40 pesetas to 2,495 with 3.4 million shares traded. Repsol jumped 90 pesetas to 4,510 with just under one million shares exchanging hands.
Volume during the session reached 58.2 billion pesetas.
